answer_1.quote: We experiment across 10 information-seeking datasets from the and ALCE benchmarks.

answer_2.quote: Metric To measure how training a language model with both supervision of NTP and NSP shows different aspects over the model trained with each supervision separately, we measure model performance via three metrics. Correctness and grounding performance measures the generation ability of the model and how well it utilizes knowledge from the external sequence. Retrieval performance mainly measures how well the model finds relevant sequences.

answer_3.quote: we use TRUE , a T5-11B model finetuned on various NLI datasets, to see whether the external knowledge entails a part of the response that is generated based on the knowledge.
